- Transfer reference: TRF-INV-88
- Amount: ₦250,000
- Bank status: Success — credited to your Access Bank account 0234567891
- Credited at: 21 November 2026, 14:02 UTC
- Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088

The "failed" status on our dashboard was outdated/incorrect. I won't resend the payment, since the bank confirms you've already been credited — resending would mean a duplicate payment.

Please check your account statement (or with your bank) for the credit around that timestamp using the session ID above. If you truly don't see it in your account, get back to me and we'll take it up with the bank using that session ID as proof.

Apologies for the confusion on the status display.
